displayNameCn: 罗曼努斯三世·阿尔吉罗斯
fullNameCn: 拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯三世·阿尔吉罗斯
birthPlaceCn: 拜占庭帝国希拉波利斯
deathPlaceCn: 拜占庭帝国君士坦丁堡

events.label: Was compelled to divorce and marry Zoe Porphyrogenita
events.labelCn: 被迫离婚并迎娶紫衣贵族佐伊
events.note: The dying Constantine VIII selected Romanos, then a senior Constantinopolitan official, to marry his daughter Zoe and continue the Macedonian succession.

events.label: Became Byzantine emperor through marriage to Zoe
events.labelCn: 通过与佐伊的婚姻成为拜占庭皇帝
events.note: Romanos succeeded immediately after Constantine VIII's death, deriving decisive legitimacy from Zoe's Macedonian dynastic status.

events.label: Was defeated near Azaz during his Syrian campaign
events.labelCn: 叙利亚远征中在阿扎兹附近战败
events.note: Romanos personally led a campaign against the Mirdasids of Aleppo but suffered a humiliating defeat and difficult retreat.

events.label: Died in his bath under suspicious circumstances
events.note: Romanos was found dead in the palace bath. Contemporary narratives differ over whether he drowned naturally, was murdered by servants, or was killed in a plot involving Zoe and Michael the Paphlagonian.

sourceNote: Michael Psellos, Chronographia; John Skylitzes, A Synopsis of Byzantine History (Cambridge); Oxford Dictionary of Byzantium; The Cambridge History of the Byzantine Empire, 'Belle Époque or Crisis? (1025–1118)'; Metropolitan Museum and Dumbarton Oaks numismatic evidence; Wikipedia supplementary chronology.
notes:
Romanos III did not inherit through blood: Constantine VIII compelled his marriage to Zoe so that a male aristocrat could rule alongside the Macedonian heiress. His death allowed Zoe immediately to elevate Michael IV through a second marriage.
